lec1.question: Write a Python program that reads two integers and prints their absolute difference. If the difference is greater than 50 print "Large Difference".
lec1.defaultCode:
a = int(input())
b = int(input())

diff = abs(a - b)

print(diff)

if diff > 50:
    print("Large Difference")
